answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 27588 Country: India Title: Can anybody be rewarded the sawwab of Takbir-e-ula if he joins before first ruku of namaz? Question: Can anybody be rewarded the sawwab of Takbir-e-ula if he joins before first ruku of namaz? Answer ID: 27588 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1806/1313/L=1431) Yes, one shall get the reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
